peerGroup.rule: same class (ec), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 26.8% below its local comparables; 1 of 37 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (0.0): 1.7 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 0 of 46 similar developments. Context, not scored: resales in 45.8% of months (24 months).

rentalYield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash. Lease: 99 yrs from 2003.

rules.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
rules.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
rules.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (ec), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $1,462,025 ($1,132 psf, 1,270–1,302 sq ft; 6 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 3 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,547 psf (range $1,266–1,596); 26.8% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $536,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Yew Tee MRT about 380 m, Choa Chu Kang MRT about 1,650 m; closer than 31 of 46 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 4 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Yew Tee Primary School about 280 m; more than 31 of 46 similar developments (the same as 10). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 1 supermarket within 1 km (nearest about 520 m), more than 0 of 46 similar developments (the same as 1); nearest hawker centre Yew Tee Hawker Centre about 570 m; nearest park Rail Corridor about 190 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: No other EC development sold new homes within 2 km. Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 9 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 0 new sales and 123 resales (123 purchases); new sales were 0% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 123 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 2 of 46 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 123 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 152 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−19.1%). Planning-area private resales −24.9%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
